name: Haus Alpenblick
beschreibung: Haus Alpenblick is an inn in Gerlos, Tirol. The establishment is located in a quiet setting on the edge of town. Guests can book rooms with breakfast or half board. The restaurant serves regional and seasonal dishes. The accommodation serves as a starting point for hikes and ski tours. Amenities include a sauna and a lounge. The inn is open year-round.
